definitions.gloss: to deny, to negate, to dismiss
definitions.explanation: To deny something that was said or claimed; to refute or contradict a statement.
When one thing cancels out or neutralizes the effect of another.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{噂|うわさ}を{打|う}ち{消|け}した。
{広報|こうほう}{担当者|たんとうしゃ}は{報道|ほうどう}を{強|つよ}く{打|う}ち{消|け}した。
examples.english: The spokesperson strongly denied the news report.

examples.japanese: {利益|りえき}が{損失|そんしつ}を{打|う}ち{消|け}した。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive).

COMPOUND VERB: Formed from {打|う}つ (to strike) + {消|け}す (to erase). The combination creates the meaning of 'striking something out' or 'erasing by striking.'

GRAMMAR NOTE: In grammar, {打|う}ち{消|け}し refers to negation (e.g., {打|う}ち{消|け}しの{助動詞|じょどうし} 'negative auxiliary verb').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{噂|うわさ}を{打|う}ち{消|け}す (deny a rumor)
・{報道|ほうどう}を{打|う}ち{消|け}す (deny a report)
・{疑惑|ぎわく}を{打|う}ち{消|け}す (dismiss suspicions)
